info.p: Prerequisite: Ensure you have the following tools handy:

ul.li: the (found in the SMS shipment box)
four batteries (found in the SMS shipment box)

step.cmd: Log in to the on your mobile device with your credentials.
Tap Dashboard or Motors on the bottom of the screen.
Do one of the following:

ul.li: If this is the first being added to your account, tap Add new SMS device to start commissioning the .

fig.title: Dashboard tabà Add new SMS device screen
Motors tab à Add new SMS device screen

ul.li: If s have been added previously, navigate to Motors.

step.cmd: Tap Add Location.
Assign a location, plant, and process to the motor.
Tap Add Motor and continue from Step 5.
In the Locations Permissions screen, tap Allow Access. In the pop-up that appears, tap Allow W hile U sing A pp.

fig.title: Location Permissions screen on iOS device

info.note: The app requires your location information to access Wi-Fi information. This screen appears only if location access has not already been granted.

step.cmd: In the next screen, confirm the name of the current Wi-Fi network connected to the mobile device and ensure it is functional.

info.note: You can also test the network at this point again by tapping Test Network . The will validate the Wi-Fi network .

step.cmd: Tap Use Network.

info.note: If you want to use another network, tap Select another network .
info.p: The next screen prompts you to insert the batteries into the .

step.cmd: Remove the four outer screws of the and remove the orange cover.

info.p: Caution: Handle the device carefully to avoid damage to the battery or internal components.

fig.title: Battery holder in the and the Wi-Fi network generated by the

step.cmd: Insert the four batteries on either side of the battery holder.
Place the orange cover back and tighten the screws. Ensure that the foam area covers the battery holder.

fig.title: Position of the orange cover before re-inserting the screws

step.cmd: On the , tap Batteries have been inserted. Powering up the device will generate a Wi-Fi network with the same numbering as the device, for example: SMS00000413A.

ul.li: The following section describes the process of establishing a connection between the mobile device and the Wi-Fi network generated by the .
This process must be completed within 5 minutes because the network cannot remain active any longer.

If for any reason you do not succeed in commissioning the device within the 5-minute timeframe, then remove the batteries, wait for roughly 20 seconds, re-insert the batteries, and start the process again.

step.cmd: Access your smartphone or tablet’s Wi-Fi settings.

info.note: This step is not applicable for Android devices.

step.cmd: Connect to the Wi-Fi network starting with ‘SMS’. Wait until the blue tick appears to confirm that the connection with the has been established.
Return to the .

info.p: Note: When using an iOS device, if it takes more than 90 seconds for the connection to be established. You may see a pop-up message asking you if you want to use cellular data instead of Wi-Fi. Select Keep Trying Wi-Fi.

fig.title: Add New SMS screen with instructions

step.cmd: Once connected, tap Next Step. The list of available local Wi-Fi networks will appear.
Select the plant’s Wi-Fi network, enter its password and tap Save.

Process of an connecting to the plant's Wi-Fi network

result.p: The and the app will now communicate with one another and the to securely establish a connection.
